description: Search SUNAT's published taxpayer register by company name (razon social) -- legal entities only (RUC prefix 20 and government offices); natural persons are excluded entirely and are never returned. Accent-insensitive substring match: every word of 3+ letters must appear in the name. Active registrations are listed before deregistered ones. Optionally restrict to a place with a ubigeo prefix (2 digits = department, e.g. "15" Lima; 4 = province; 6 = district). Returns RUC, name, status and address so you can pick the right one.

active_only.description: If true, return only registrations whose status is ACTIVO (default false: active first, then the rest).

name.description: Company name or part of it, e.g. "BANCO DE CREDITO" or "alicorp".

ubigeo.description: Optional ubigeo prefix: 2, 4 or 6 digits (e.g. "15" Lima department, "150122" Miraflores).

name: pe_ruc_search
title: Pe Ruc Search
